title: It makes little sense to use one rubric for our classes, one rubric for student teaching, ine rubric for EdTPA, and then a different rubric on the job
summary: It makes little sense to use one rubric for our classes, one rubric for student teaching, ine rubric for EdTPA, and then a different rubric on the job. Wouldn't it make more sense to train the skills and practices expected in teachers when teaching trainings.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: It makes little sense to use one rubric for our classes, one rubric for student teaching, ine rubric for EdTPA, and then a different rubric on the job. Wouldn't it make more sense to train the skills and practices expected in teachers when teaching trainings.
